meta.description: Workflow A v1: authenticated webhook -> 202 ack -> prompt (architecture-v1) -> Gemma -> schema validation -> one bounded repair attempt -> idempotent callbacks. Callback secret is injected by scripts/n8n-provision.ts; committed copy keeps the placeholder. Transient Gemma failures: 3 tries with backoff. Model/prompt version recorded in the job result.

parameters.jsCode:
const v = $json;
const prep = $('Prepare').first().json;
const prompt = [
  'OUTPUT FORMAT (critical): your entire reply must be ONE JSON object. The first character must be { and the last must be }. No markdown, no bullets, no reasoning.',
  '',
  'Your previous reply could not be used. Validation error: ' + v.error.message,
  '',
  'Previous reply (truncated):',
  v.rawText,
  '',
  'Reply shape:',
  '{"title": string, "mermaid": string, "explanation": string, "assumptions": string[]}',
  '',
  'Original task:',
  prep.prompt
].join('\n');
return [{ json: { jobId: v.jobId, prompt } }];
